ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a shape made of identical gray squares. In the middle is a rectangular block array with 2 columns and 3 rows, totaling 6 squares; in the middle row, 1 extra square is attached on each of the left and right sides, so there are 8 squares in total. Counting along the outer boundary, the perimeter of the shape consists of 14 square sides of the same length. Reasoning: The problem gives that the perimeter of the whole shape is 42 cm, and the outer boundary has 14 equal-length sides, so the side length of each small square is 42 ÷ 14 = 3 cm. The area of one small square is 3 × 3 = 9 cm². The shape is composed of 8 squares of the same size, so the total area is 8 × 9 = 72 cm².

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the figure is a grid shape made of a central 2-by-3 block of squares, with one additional square attached to the left of the middle row and one additional square attached to the right of the middle row, for 8 squares total. Count the number of exposed unit-square sides around the outside boundary: the outline consists of 14 equal side-length segments. From the text, the total perimeter is 42 cm, so one square side is 42/14 = 3 cm. Since the text says there are 8 equally sized squares, the total area is 8 times the area of one square: 8 × 3^2 = 72 cm^2.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the shape fits inside a 4-squares-wide by 3-squares-tall rectangle, with the four corner squares missing; equivalently, only the middle row spans all 4 positions, while the top and bottom rows have only the central 2 squares. Use this bounding-rectangle view to get the perimeter in unit lengths. A 4-by-3 rectangle has perimeter 2(4 + 3) = 14 unit sides, and cutting out each corner square does not change the total perimeter because two outside unit sides are removed and two new inside unit sides are added. Therefore the given shape also has 14 unit side lengths around its boundary. With total perimeter 42 cm, each unit side is 42/14 = 3 cm. The area is 8 equal squares, so area = 8 × 3^2 = 72 cm^2.
